title: Acquirer: Carter Holt Harvey Ltd; Target: MGP 10 Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: Carter Holt Harvey Limited (CHH) proposes to acquire all shares in a company known as MGP 10 Pty Limited, which owns and operates a softwood sawmill business at Morwell, Victoria. The softwood sawmill business is known as "Brown & Dureau (B&D).
body_sections.Market definition: For the purposes of competition analysis the proposed acquisition was considered in relation to the national market for the supply of softwood sawmill products.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The Commission's concentration thresholds are not crossed. In addition, imports constitute well over 10% of this market.
